scope: Four audit findings: named-map attachment, adapter replacement, pending native navigation, and duplicate camera validation/conversion helpers.
changes: Named useMap returns undefined while absent and follows attachment; enclosing useMap retains its required MapRef return type.
MapSetup requires a new React key when the adapter changes, resetting readiness and pending interactions.
Native navigation uses the existing committed callback guard and verifies map identity before dispatching a delayed zoom command.
One finite-number validator preserves each caller's error message; RNMapbox flyTo uses the existing camera converter directly.

regressions.beforeFixes: Named initial attachment, unkeyed adapter replacement, navigation after control removal, and navigation after map replacement all failed as expected.
regressions.afterFixes: All pass, including StrictMode named removal/reattachment, keyed adapter readiness and pending-query reset, camera failure propagation, and finite-number rejection.

testScriptSubcommands.execution: Every command in package.json scripts.test ran in separate source, native, standalone-script, and process-cleanup groups. The Node and Bun process-cleanup tests ran with local process permissions; neither launches a renderer.

checks.manualReview: Reviewed changed callers, preserved validation and error handling, emitted hook overloads, current documentation and example usage. Historical acceptance records remain unchanged.

diagnostics: Nonblocking Bun moduleSuffixes and experimental TypeScript API warnings remained visible; the build reported 17 React Compiler optimization diagnostics.

acceptance.reason: Explicitly deferred by the owner. Actual renderer timing and interactions remain unverified for these repairs.

retention: Packed consumers and temporary archives cleaned themselves up. No raw test logs or screenshots were retained.
